subject: Checkpointed original-client ordinary movement from Conrad usable toward crashed dropship under mission 1995 timer
setup: Isolated copied client/server/character DB after S5 objective 3 completion in run 09. Normal hostile behavior and original 1.16.5.0 compatibility client. The 600-second wall-clock timer was preserved; no GM travel or timer reset. Because movement was not saved on forced harness shutdown, each subsequent copied login coordinate was explicitly edited to the prior run’s ordinary-reached .where coordinate. No live Docker/DIT edits.

observations.finding: From manually restored run-11 water coordinate, ordinary movement around the water edge reached (-152.148,79.273,9.367), still at water elevation. The candidate bank recovery did not climb.

From manually restored run-12 water coordinate, ordinary movement reached (-150.035,79.270,3.438), still beneath the bridge. The client no longer displayed the S5 tracker. Copied DB mission 1995 mission_state=2 and objective 1 status=3, with objective 2/3 status=2 and timer anchor cleared. The run-09 timer anchor was 1790227161182 ms; this is consistent with expiration after 600 seconds of wall clock. No wreck use request or damage was observed.

The navmesh can path from the corpse to the wreck via (-127.6,83.71,36.0) and (-194.8,95.51,-33.2), but the client-run route veered below the bank after (-131.8,84.89,23.71). From the water it suggests a loop back up near (-135,84,15). These are route hypotheses and do not verify original client traversal.

assessment: The objective-3-to-wreck timer and ordinary movement to the southwest route were verified in the isolated client. This attempt missed the higher bank, consumed the wall-clock timer, and failed mission 1995. It does not prove a wreck placement, usability, combat, or timer defect. The next replay should keep the route on the higher bank after (-131.8,84.9,23.7), then approach the inferred wreck before the timer expires.
